missionInfo.heading: Wardlow House
paragraphs: Wardlow House clings to a cliff above a hungry sea. Its first owner, a locksmith, hid thirteen keys in its walls.
Your grandmother Odette has died. Her family forgot the keys, but a voice in the old keyholes has not forgotten them.
You are Mara Wardlow, with your brother Teo. Find the keys and reach the cliff cave before the tide covers it. You have 10:00.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag to look around the room. Glowing things can be tapped.

tutorial.title: Tap and take
tutorial.text: Tap an object to inspect or take it. Items go into your Book.

tutorial.title: Keys
tutorial.text: Open the Key Ring to see your keys. Every key has a power.

tutorial.title: Puzzles
tutorial.text: Every puzzle has an X to close it and a Pause button. Closing keeps your progress.

tutorial.title: Wards, hints, clock
tutorial.text: You earn Wards for finds and keys. A wrong answer costs 10. You have 3 hints, 25 Wards each. The clock is 10:00 and keeps running while a hint is spoken.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Night. The tide is coming in. Mara and Teo stand inside the doors of Wardlow House.

opening.speaker: teo
opening.text: Grandma left us a house full of locks. Of course she did.

opening.speaker: mara
opening.text: She left a letter too. "Find the keys before the tide."

opening.speaker: teo
opening.text: Which keys? And why does that keyhole feel like it is listening?

opening.speaker: warden
opening.text: Come in, Mara. Come in, Teo. Quickly. I will help you.

idle.speaker: teo
idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

ui.timeUpLine: The tide covered the cave, and the house forgot again.

keys.name: Lantern Key
keys.power: Shows what hides in the dark.

keys.name: Hall Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Library.

keys.name: Reading Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Dining Hall.

keys.name: Guest Key
keys.power: Lets the old guests of the house appear and speak.

keys.name: Banquet Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Clock Cellar.

keys.name: Clock Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Well House.

keys.name: Well Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Study.

keys.name: Vault Key
keys.power: Opens the door to the Cliff Cave.

keys.name: Master Key
keys.power: Locks the Warden away, or lets it out.

lantern_shell.title: Brass Lantern
lantern_shell.text: An old lantern with no flame. It needs something special to light it.

pin_rods.title: Pin Rods
pin_rods.text: Five brass rods of different lengths. They fit a pin lock.

key_blank.title: Key Blank
key_blank.text: A plain key with eight teeth. It can be filed to fit a lock.

steel_file.title: Steel File
steel_file.text: A small file. It can cut away the teeth of a key.

place_cards.title: Place Cards
place_cards.text: Five faded name cards. They were made for a dinner table.

silver_bell.title: Silver Bell
silver_bell.text: A small dinner bell. It has a clear, sweet ring.

oil_can.title: Oil Can
oil_can.text: An old can of oil. Good for stiff, rusty parts.

brass_crank.title: Brass Crank
brass_crank.text: A winding crank. It might open a stuck panel.

bucket5.title: Big Bucket
bucket5.text: A wooden bucket with a 5 painted on it. It holds five measures.

bucket3.title: Small Bucket
bucket3.text: A wooden bucket with a 3 painted on it. It holds three measures.

safe_crank.title: Safe Crank
safe_crank.text: A heavy iron handle. It fits a safe.

loupe.title: Loupe
loupe.text: A brass magnifying glass. Faint ink might show up under it.

lantern.caption: A little girl holds a lantern in the hall.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: Dark does not hide things. It keeps them safe until you are ready.

mirror.caption: A little girl reads the diary in the mirror, laughing.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: Some truths only face you in reflection.

guest.caption: A little boy hides under the table while ghosts sit down.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: They sit so the door stays shut.

quiet.caption: Odette stops every clock in the cellar.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: It moves between the ticks, children. Hold your breath.

tide.caption: The children watch the tide climb the well wall. Odette marks the line.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: The sea is its door, and I closed it.

memory.caption: The study, on the night of the high tide.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: Fifteen years ago, on the night of the high tide.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: The first lock slipped. The Warden spoke through every keyhole in this house.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: Mara held the lantern. Teo rang the bell. Together you helped me seal it.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: But it asked what you missed most. And you both said, "Mum."

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: So I used this key to make you forget. Forgive me.

lines.speaker: odette
lines.text: It will offer you everything you miss. Never believe the voice.

inscriptions: It hides in the dark. Show it the light.
It speaks backwards. Make it read true.
It wears a guest's welcome. Let the guests speak.
It moves between the ticks. Stop the clocks.
It rises with the sea. Lower the water.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.objective: Find a way to open the Library door.
rooms.intro: Wardlow House is dark and silent. Look around the hall. Find what you need to open the big lock on the Library door.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: So many keyholes. Every door, every chest.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: Somebody really liked locks. And hid something behind the portrait, I bet.

d_page1.speaker: mara
d_page1.text: Tall in the middle. That is a rule for the pins.

d_sweep.speaker: teo
d_sweep.text: The marks stop at three pins. Someone scraped the rest.

wrong1.speaker: teo
wrong1.text: Nope. That pin sticks. Check the marks again?

wrong2.speaker: mara
wrong2.text: The scratches only cover some pins. Odette's page covers the rest.

wrong3.speaker: teo
wrong3.text: We know three heights. The page says the middle one is tallest.

hint1.speaker: mara
hint1.text: The lantern might show something on that dark wall.

hint2.speaker: teo
hint2.text: Read the diary page, then count the tally marks.

hint3.speaker: mara
hint3.text: Heights 4, 2 and 1 are known. The middle pin is the tallest of all.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: And there is a key in it. The Hall Key.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: Well done. Quickly now. The Library is waiting.

note.title: Odette's Letter
note.text: "Find the keys before the tide." Odette left this for her grandchildren.

hotspots.name: Portrait of Ambrose
hotspots.title: Portrait of Ambrose
hotspots.text1: Ambrose Wardlow, the locksmith who built this house. He holds a big key in his hand.
hotspots.text2: The frame is hollow at the back! Carved inside: "13 keys, 13 hooks."

hotspots.name: Lantern Key
hotspots.text: It was hidden behind the portrait. Hold it, then use it on the lantern in your Book.

result.title: The Lantern Lights
result.text: The key's power wakes the lantern. A warm light shines. Maybe it can show something on the dark wall.

note.title: Diary Page 1
note.text: Pins rise as the family does. Tall in the middle, short at the end.

hotspots.name: Dark wall
hotspots.text: The wall is too dark to see. A light might help.

hotspots.name: Hall Key
hotspots.text: The lock turned and the Hall Key was waiting inside. The Library door is open to you now.

hotspots.name: Library door
hotspots.useHint: The door to the Library is locked. You need a key.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Hall Key turns. The door swings open to the Library.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.objective: Make a key that fits the Dining Hall door.
rooms.intro: Odette's library holds many secrets. Find a key blank and a file, and learn which teeth must be cut away.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: Books everywhere. And a mirror the size of a door.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: Odette's desk. Let's see what she read.

d_mirror.speaker: teo
d_mirror.text: Whoa. The writing flips. It reads fine in the mirror.

d_page2.speaker: mara
d_page2.text: File the blocked teeth. Keep the thumb tooth.

wrong1.speaker: teo
wrong1.text: The key jammed. We filed a wrong tooth, or missed one.

wrong2.speaker: mara
wrong2.text: Check all three plates. A tooth is blocked if any plate blocks it.

wrong3.speaker: teo
wrong3.text: Tooth 5 shows up on two plates. Count each place once.

hint1.speaker: teo
hint1.text: That mirror looks awake. What does it show on the plates?

hint2.speaker: mara
hint2.text: Read the page again. File only the teeth that a plate blocks.

hint3.speaker: teo
hint3.text: Plates block 1, 2, 5 and 7. Leave the thumb tooth alone.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: Odette wrote her warnings backwards. Smart.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: Good. The Dining Hall next. Quickly.

hotspots.name: Globe
hotspots.title: The Globe
hotspots.text1: An old globe on a brass stand. Seas and coasts are painted in faded ink.
hotspots.text2: A tiny red pin sits on the sea. It marks a cave under the cliff.
hotspots.secret: A red pin marks the sea cave

hotspots.name: Hollow book
hotspots.title: "Coastal Locks"
hotspots.text1: A thick old book called "Coastal Locks". It looks odd.
hotspots.text2: The pages are cut out. Something is hidden in the hollow!

hotspots.name: Mirror Key
hotspots.text: It was hidden in the hollow book. Use it on the dusty wall mirror.

hotspots.name: Wall mirror
hotspots.useHint: A huge mirror, dull with dust. It looks asleep. Something here could wake it.

result.title: The Mirror Wakes
result.text: The glass clears and glows. The room shows backwards in it, and old writing turns the right way round.

note.title: Diary Page 2
note.text: A key must pass every ward. File away any tooth a plate blocks. Never file the thumb tooth, number 8.

hotspots.name: Reading Key
hotspots.text: The filed key slid through every ward and became the Reading Key. The Dining Hall door is open to you now.

hotspots.name: Dining Hall door
hotspots.useHint: The door to the Dining Hall is locked.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Reading Key turns. The heavy oak door opens.

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.objective: Find out where the five guests sit.
rooms.intro: A dining table is laid for five. Find the guests' memory, make them speak, and seat each one in the right chair.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: A table laid for five. Nobody has eaten here in years.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: The chairs have brass teeth under the seats. It is a lock.

d_ghosts.speaker: teo
d_ghosts.text: Ghosts. Great. At least they are polite.

d_clues.speaker: mara
d_clues.text: Two of them told us exactly where they sit.

wrong1.speaker: teo
wrong1.text: A ghost frowned at us. That seat is not theirs.

wrong2.speaker: mara
wrong2.text: Start with the two who said exactly where they sit.

wrong3.speaker: teo
wrong3.text: Pell sits beside the Captain. Ashby is nearer the fire than Pell.

hint1.speaker: mara
hint1.text: Ring the bell and listen to every guest.

hint2.speaker: teo
hint2.text: Wren and Brine tell us their seats outright. Place them first.

hint3.speaker: mara
hint3.text: Wren is 1 and Brine is 3. That leaves Pell, Ashby and Quill for 2, 4 and 5.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: They all sat down at once. The teeth lined up.

right.speaker: mara
right.text: Odette's memory said the guests keep a door shut. I wonder which door.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: Lovely. The cellar next. Quickly, the tide will not wait.

hotspots.name: Glass decanter
hotspots.title: Glass Decanter
hotspots.text1: A fine glass decanter. Something small glints inside.
hotspots.text2: A key is lying at the bottom of the glass!

hotspots.name: Guest Key
hotspots.text: It was inside the decanter. Use it on the long table.

hotspots.name: Fireplace
hotspots.title: The Fireplace
hotspots.text1: A huge stone fireplace. The fire still burns, though nobody lit it.
hotspots.text2: Words are carved in the lintel: "Mind the tide."

note.title: Diary Page 3
note.text: The guests sit by the fire's rule. Closer to the fire is higher in rank.

hotspots.name: Long table
hotspots.useHint: A long table laid for five. Someone should be sitting here.

result.title: The Guests Appear
result.text: Five pale ghosts sit down at the table. They are silent. They look like they want to talk.

hotspots.name: Ring the bell
hotspots.useHint: The ghosts are silent. Maybe a bell would make them speak.

result.title: The Bell Rings
result.text: A clear ring fills the hall. The ghosts turn their heads. Now each one will speak.

note.title: Lady Wren
note.text: "I am warming my hands at the fire."

note.title: Captain Brine
note.text: "I sit in the middle. I always sit in the middle."

note.title: Dr. Pell
note.text: "I sit beside the Captain. His stories need a doctor."

note.title: Miss Ashby
note.text: "I sit nearer the fire than Dr. Pell."

note.title: Mr. Quill
note.text: "I am left with whatever seat remains."

hotspots.name: Banquet Key
hotspots.text: The guests sat down and the brass teeth lined up. The Banquet Key rose from the table. The cellar door is open to you now.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Banquet Key turns. The iron door swings open.

rooms.name: Clock Cellar
rooms.objective: Quiet the clocks and fix the chime levers.
rooms.intro: The cellar is full of ticking clocks. Silence them, free the stuck levers, and put them all in the right position.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: It is so loud in here. All those clocks ticking.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: I cannot hear myself think. Or panic.

d_page4.speaker: mara
d_page4.text: Each lever wakes its neighbours. Think of it as a chain.

wrong1.speaker: teo
wrong1.text: That made it worse. Each lever wakes its neighbours.

wrong2.speaker: mara
wrong2.text: The end levers only wake one neighbour. Start from the right end.

wrong3.speaker: teo
wrong3.text: Pressing a lever twice undoes it. Fewer presses, please.

hint1.speaker: mara
hint1.text: Page four says each lever wakes its neighbours too.

hint2.speaker: teo
hint2.text: Work from the right. Only lever 4 can fix lever 4 and 3 together.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: The case sleeps. And a key fell out of it.

right.speaker: mara
right.text: Hold your breath, she said. The Warden moves between the ticks.

s_pendulum.speaker: warden
s_pendulum.text: Leave the pendulum. Pull the levers. Quickly.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: The well next. Mind the tide. Quickly.

hotspots.name: Stopped clock
hotspots.title: A Stopped Clock
hotspots.text1: One clock on the bench has stopped. Its back looks loose.
hotspots.text2: The back is hollow. A key is hidden inside!

hotspots.name: Quiet Key
hotspots.text: It was inside the stopped clock. Use it on the swinging pendulum.

hotspots.name: Big clock face
hotspots.title: The Big Clock Face
hotspots.text1: The great clock's hands are stuck near midnight.
hotspots.text2: Five minutes to twelve. Scratched below: "Hold your breath."

hotspots.name: Pendulum
hotspots.useHint: The pendulum swings and ticks, loud and steady.

result.title: The Ticking Stops
result.text: The pendulum slows and stops. The cellar goes quiet. The levers on the case stop shaking.

hotspots.name: Stuck panel
hotspots.useHint: A brass panel is stuck shut. Something could wind it open.

result.title: The Panel Opens
result.text: The crank turns. The panel slides open. Four chime levers are inside, but they are stiff.

hotspots.name: Stiff levers
hotspots.useHint: The levers are rusty and will not move.

result.title: The Levers Move
result.text: A little oil, and the levers swing freely.

note.title: Diary Page 4
note.text: Each chime lever wakes its neighbours too. Leave every lever up and the case sleeps.

hotspots.name: Clock Key
hotspots.text: The case fell asleep and the Clock Key dropped out. The iron door is open to you now.

hotspots.name: Iron door
hotspots.useHint: The iron door with the clock face is locked.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Clock Key turns. The iron door opens onto a stairway.

rooms.name: Well House
rooms.objective: Lower the water to the fourth notch.
rooms.intro: The sea is right outside. Find two buckets, lower the water, and measure out exactly four.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: The sea is right outside. You can feel it in the stones.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: Four notches. Is that a tide chart or a ladder to nowhere?

d_water.speaker: mara
d_water.text: There is a lock in the grate. And a basin.

d_page5.speaker: teo
d_page5.text: Four, with a five and a three. That is a puzzle, not a poem.

wrong1.speaker: mara
wrong1.text: Not four. The basin wants exactly the fourth notch.

wrong2.speaker: teo
wrong2.text: We only measure with these two buckets. Fill, pour, empty.

wrong3.speaker: mara
wrong3.text: Fill the five and pour it into the three. See what is left in the five.

hint1.speaker: teo
hint1.text: Page five says five buckets, then three. The tide stops at four.

hint2.speaker: mara
hint2.text: Pour from the big bucket into the small one and look at what remains.

hint3.speaker: teo
hint3.text: Fill five, pour into three, empty three, pour the two across, fill five, top up three.

right.speaker: mara
right.text: Four, exactly. The grate clicked open.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: The sea is a door. I do not like that.

s_well.speaker: warden
s_well.text: The tide is rising. Quickly, quickly. Lower the water.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: Only the Study left, and then the cave. Quickly.

hotspots.name: Crab pot
hotspots.title: The Crab Pot
hotspots.text1: A wooden crab pot, wet with sea water. Something shines inside.
hotspots.text2: A key is caught in the wicker. It must have been here a long time.

hotspots.name: Tide Key
hotspots.text: It was caught in the crab pot. Use it on the well.

hotspots.name: Notch wall
hotspots.title: The Notch Wall
hotspots.text1: A carved wall with four notches at rising heights. A tide chart!
hotspots.text2: The fourth notch has the Wardlow mark. The tide must stop there.
hotspots.secret: The 4th notch has the Wardlow mark

hotspots.name: The well
hotspots.useHint: The well is full to the brim. A rusted grate lies under the water.

result.title: The Water Drops
result.text: The water sinks. A rusty grate lock and a stone basin show.

note.title: Diary Page 5
note.text: The tide stops at the fourth notch. Five buckets I had, then three.

hotspots.name: Well Key
hotspots.text: Exactly four. The grate clicked open and the Well Key rose from the water. The Study door is open to you now.

hotspots.name: Study door
hotspots.useHint: The mossy oak door is locked.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Well Key turns. The mossy door creaks open.

rooms.name: Locksmith's Study
rooms.intro: This was Odette's study. Find a crank for the safe, wake the hidden clue cards, and work out the secret code.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: This was Odette's study. I remember the smell of ink.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: I remember nothing. Is that normal?

d_flash.speaker: mara
d_flash.text: We helped her. We were there.

d_flash.speaker: teo
d_flash.text: And the voice has been helping us ever since. I think it is the Warden.

d_cards.speaker: mara
d_cards.text: Odette kept old guesses. We can work out the code.

wrong1.speaker: teo
wrong1.text: The safe grumbled. Some symbols were right, some were not.

wrong2.speaker: mara
wrong2.text: Compare the cards. One card has no symbol in the right place.

wrong3.speaker: teo
wrong3.text: Card four has two symbols in place. Start there.

hint1.speaker: mara
hint1.text: The Memory Key made the cards readable. Read them all.

hint2.speaker: teo
hint2.text: Card four has two in place and one that is not in the code.

hint3.speaker: mara
hint3.text: Eye is first. Key is last. Moon is in the middle.

right.speaker: mara
right.text: It opened. Eye, Moon, Key. She hid it in the oldest riddle.

right.speaker: teo
right.text: One more key. And a very big door.

s_cards.speaker: warden
s_cards.text: Do not bother with the cards. Try every combination. Quickly.

s_key.speaker: warden
s_key.text: The cave. Bring everything. Quickly, quickly.

hotspots.name: Small brass box
hotspots.title: The Brass Box
hotspots.text1: A small brass box sits on the desk. Its lid has a strange little lock-plate with no keyhole.
hotspots.text2: The lid slides open. A pale key lies inside, wrapped in cloth.

hotspots.name: Memory Key
hotspots.text: It was in the brass box. Use it on the four blank cards.

hotspots.name: Ink blotter
hotspots.title: The Ink Blotter
hotspots.text1: An old ink blotter. Faint marks are pressed into it.
hotspots.text2: Held up to a mirror in your mind, it reads: "The 13th hook stays empty."

hotspots.name: Blank cards
hotspots.useHint: Four blank cards are pinned on the desk. They look empty.

result.title: Ghost Ink Appears
result.text: Pale writing rises on the cards: symbols and tiny marks. It is too faint to read without help.

hotspots.name: Clue card 1
hotspots.text: The ink is too faint to read. You need something to magnify it.

note.title: Clue Card 1
note.text: Card 1: Moon, Wave, Flame. 0 in the right place, 1 in the wrong place.

hotspots.name: Clue card 2
hotspots.text: The ink is too faint to read. You need something to magnify it.

note.title: Clue Card 2
note.text: Card 2: Eye, Key, Leaf. 1 in the right place, 1 in the wrong place.

hotspots.name: Clue card 3
hotspots.text: The ink is too faint to read. You need something to magnify it.

note.title: Clue Card 3
note.text: Card 3: Key, Moon, Wave. 1 in the right place, 1 in the wrong place.

hotspots.name: Clue card 4
hotspots.text: The ink is too faint to read. You need something to magnify it.

note.title: Clue Card 4
note.text: Card 4: Eye, Flame, Key. 2 in the right place, 0 in the wrong place.

note.title: Diary Page 6
note.text: Eye, Moon, Key. I hid my answer in the order of the oldest riddle. Do not trust the voice that asks you to hurry.

hotspots.name: Vault Key
hotspots.text: The safe swung open and the Vault Key lay inside. The Cliff Cave door is open to you now.

hotspots.name: Cliff Cave door
hotspots.useHint: The iron door with the fish-scale lock is shut tight.

result.title: The Door Opens
result.text: The Vault Key turns. Cold sea air blows in. The cave is waiting.

rooms.name: Cliff Cave
rooms.objective: Find the lock, open it, then decide the Master Key's turn.
rooms.intro: The tide is rising in the cave. Find the sightline to the hidden lock, open its five small locks with the right keys, and turn the Master Key.

enter.speaker: mara
enter.text: The cave. Odette's red pin on the globe was right.

enter.speaker: teo
enter.text: Is the sea always this loud, or is it hurrying us?

d_note.speaker: mara
d_note.text: Line up the posts and the lighthouse. Like a ship's sightline.

wrong1.speaker: mara
wrong1.text: That key does not fit. Read the inscription again.

wrong2.speaker: teo
wrong2.text: Every key has one power. Match the power to the words.

wrong3.speaker: mara
wrong3.text: Dark, backwards, guests, ticking, tide. Five powers, five locks.

hint1.speaker: teo
hint1.text: Turn until the two posts and the lighthouse stack up like a line.

hint2.speaker: mara
hint2.text: Think back to what each power did in its room.

hint3.speaker: teo
hint3.text: Lantern for dark, Mirror for backwards, Guest for guests, Quiet for ticks, Tide for the sea.

right1.speaker: mara
right1.text: There. The beam found the lock.

right2.speaker: teo
right2.text: All five hold. And the thirteenth key came up out of the lock.

right3.speaker: teo
right3.text: It is quiet. I think it is gone.

s_warden.speaker: warden
s_warden.text: I only wanted to help. Turn it toward the sea, Mara. I will give you your mother. Quickly.

s_reply.speaker: mara
s_reply.text: No. Odette told us never to believe the voice.

s_sea.speaker: teo
s_sea.text: It is lying! Pull it back, Mara!

note.title: Carved Note
note.text: "Face the lamp, line the posts, and the door shows itself."

hotspots.name: Master Key
hotspots.text: The five small locks hold. The great lock hums, and the thirteenth key rises to the centre keyhole: the Master Key.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Master Key turned toward the sea. The great lock groaned, and every hook on it went dark.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Thank you, Mara. Thirteen doors, and not one of them can hold me now.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: No. No, no. Mara, the water is coming in!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ink poured out of every keyhole in Wardlow House. The tide climbed the cliff, and the lamps went out one by one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By morning the manor stood empty. Only the sound of the sea remained, and a voice in the keyholes, quietly laughing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Master Key turned. All thirteen hooks glowed. The Warden's whispers faded into the sea.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: We should let the house sleep now.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Next time we inherit a house, I want one with fewer keyholes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The siblings climbed back to the hall, and the door was locked behind them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But out on the cliff, in the dark, a fourteenth keyhole opened its eye.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Master Key turned. Twelve hooks glowed. One stayed empty.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I remember her laugh. I will keep that, whatever it costs.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Then we keep watch together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Warden was sealed, but a thin line of violet light still showed beneath the door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And out on the cliff, in the dark, a fourteenth keyhole opened its eye.
